justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/pool/TypePool.java` around lines 5202-5284. `LazyTypeVariable` is a small nested helper with 6 fields, 1 constructor, and only 4 overridden accessors (`getUpperBounds`, `getTypeVariableSource`, `getSymbol`, `getDeclaredAnnotations`); it focuses on one cohesive responsibility: lazily representing a type variable and delegating bound handling to `LazyBoundTokenList`. I did not see evidence of excessive size, many public methods, or clearly separable responsibilities.
